snippet.title: Polymega Gameplays - Mega Games I [SEGA Mega Drive - PAL]
snippet.description:
Known in the US as "Triple Score: 3 Games In One", Mega Games I is a bundle composed of the following games: Super Hang-On, Columns and World Cup Italia '90 (referred in the compilation as SEGA Soccer). In Europe, the bundle came with the Mega Drive II and was not sold separately.

Mega Games, Super Hang-On, World Cup Italia '90, Columns (C) SEGA
